tagline: Desert to pines on dirt, by way of a feud.
intro: SR 288 leaves SR 188 near Roosevelt Lake and heads north into mountainous country, through the hamlet of Rock House, climbing out of the desert one biotic community at a time. Long stretches are unpaved. Between the lake and Pleasant Valley stands the Sierra Ancha, Spanish for broad range, cut by deep canyons and crossed by few improved roads.
At Young the pavement comes back for about ten miles, though no fully paved road connects the town to any other highway. North of town the byway carries on as Forest Road 512, up to SR 260.

moments.title: Young
moments.text: Pleasant Valley's town, at the center of the Graham and Tewksbury feud. Many of the men it killed are buried in Young, and Pleasant Valley Cemetery is a common stop.

moments.title: Willow Springs Lake
moments.text: Up on the Rim beside SR 260, a lake Game and Fish made in 1967. In winter people fish it through the ice.

practical: Not all sections are paved. Four-wheel drive is recommended in bad weather, and several areas get heavy snow in winter.
